generate_vs_project_guids: generate Visual Studio project GUIDs from target names using MD5 hashing
process_build_targets: process build libraries and targets to set is_library flags and VS config properties
filter_vs_projects: filter projects by platform support and build type for Visual Studio generation
create_project_lookup_dict: create a name-to-project dictionary for quick Visual Studio project lookups
set_default_vs_config: set default VS configuration type, packages, props, and project directory for targets
